CREATE TEMP TABLE tau_audio_affected_items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);
SELECT CAST(child.value AS INTEGER) FROM descendants
INSERT INTO tau_audio_affected_items SELECT id FROM descendants;
UPDATE project AS owner SET children=(
FROM expanded JOIN tau_retired_audio_items retired ON retired.id=expanded.id,
SELECT id FROM expanded WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM tau_retired_audio_items)
GROUP BY id ORDER BY MIN(position)
WHERE value IN (SELECT id FROM tau_retired_audio_items)
UPDATE project_item AS owner SET children=(
FROM expanded JOIN tau_retired_audio_items retired ON retired.id=expanded.id,
SELECT id FROM expanded WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM tau_retired_audio_items)
GROUP BY id ORDER BY MIN(position)
WHERE value IN (SELECT id FROM tau_retired_audio_items)
DELETE FROM project_item WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM tau_retired_audio_items);
UPDATE project_item AS item SET parents=(
SELECT DISTINCT parent.id FROM project_item parent,json_each(COALESCE(parent.children,'[]')) child
) WHERE item.id IN (SELECT id FROM tau_audio_affected_items)
WHERE value IN (SELECT id FROM tau_retired_audio_items)
SELECT project.id,CAST(child.value AS INTEGER) FROM project,json_each(COALESCE(project.children,'[]')) child
SELECT membership.project_id,CAST(child.value AS INTEGER) FROM membership
UPDATE project_item AS item SET projects=(
SELECT project_id FROM membership WHERE item_id=item.id ORDER BY project_id
) WHERE item.id IN (SELECT id FROM tau_audio_affected_items);
